function.name: calculate_magnetic_field
function.description: Calculate the magnetic field at a certain distance from a straight wire carrying current using Ampere’s Law. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

current.description: The current flowing through the wire in amperes. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance from the wire at which to calculate the magnetic field in meters. This is a float type value.

permeability.description: The permeability of free space. The default value is 4π × 10^−7 N/A^2. This is a float type value.

*This is the most recent CODATA‑2018 recommended value.*

  \(m_{e}c^{2}=0.510 998 950\;\text{MeV}\).

- In natural units (\(\hbar=c=1\)):  
  \(m_{e}=511~\text{keV}/c^{2}\).
